# Required paths in the Pi 4 SD UFS2 root. The staging tree is checked exactly;
# the raw UFS fallback checks the basename strings found in directory entries.
/init
/bin/brush
/bin/ls
/bin/uname
/bin/ping
/sbin/netd
/sbin/vfsd
/sbin/initfsd
/etc/passwd
/etc/group
/etc/shadow
/etc/profile
/etc/motd
/etc/drivers.toml
/etc/pi4.dtb
/etc/services.d/netd.toml
/root/.keep
